item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Lalit looks at the diagram of quadrilateral $PQRS$. All four sides carry the same tick mark. No right-angle mark is shown.

Which claim correctly classifies $PQRS$?

options.A: Call $PQRS$ a rhombus while the four sides are allowed to be unequal.
options.B: $PQRS$ is a rhombus and a parallelogram; it is not a square because no right angle is shown.
options.C: Being a parallelogram forces the four equal side lengths on $PQRS$.
options.D: Call $PQRS$ a square under the same marks, with right angles that are not shown.
